description:
The proposal comprises the demolition of the existing rear uPVC conservatory and the construction of a single-storey rear infill extension at ground floor level.

The new extension will extend across the full width of the existing rear elevation, aligning with the neighbouring built form, and will infill the current gap between the main house and rear boundary. The extension will be constructed in materials to match or complement the existing dwelling, including brickwork and a pitched tiled roof.

Internally, the ground floor layout will be reconfigured to provide an enlarged open-plan kitchen and dining space, with improved connection to the rear garden. New rooflights will be introduced within the extension roof to provide additional natural daylight to the internal spaces. (see proposed ground floor plan and roof plan)

At first floor level, no changes are proposed and the layout remains as existing.

Externally, new doors and windows will be installed to the rear elevation to serve the extended kitchen and dining area. The existing boundary treatments are retained.
